name: Computer user gridview
description:
1. **Grid view for computer sessions** — added a `Single | Grid` toggle with a session picker and three adaptive layouts (`grid` equal tiles, `spotlight` principal + filmstrip, `sidebar` principal + right rail); one tile stays live/interactive, others promote on click, `⤢` opens solo, `✕` drops, choices persist in `localStorage`.

2. **View controls moved to the left bar** — new `ComputerViewControls.vue` renders in both expanded and collapsed (68 px icon rail) states so the grid regains the full toolbar height; the "seed the wall from watched + running machines" rule moved into the `setViewMode` store action.

3. **New session dialog became a two-step wizard** — `BrowserSessionCreateModal.vue` now has Step 1 (machine & image, with recent-image tiles + "Browse the library" and a custom-image field) and Step 2 (settings), and the image library renders **inside** the same dialog instead of opening a nested modal.

4. **Sidebar redesign** — the separate chevron arrow was removed; the round brand icon at the top is now the expand/collapse toggle (`aria-expanded` + hover affordance), and the new `collapsible` prop keeps the mobile view free of a dead button.

5. **Verification** — store logic exercised against the real module, layouts and both sidebar states rendered in a throwaway Vite harness in real Chromium (widths 68↔320, `toggle-collapse` round-trips, no chevron), SFCs compile clean, and all temporary harness files were removed.

Let me check the client container to test my changes in the real UI:Vite HMR already picked up my changes with no compile error. Let me verify in the real UI:Login is required, so let me verify compilation directly against the Vite dev server instead:Let me refine two details in the tile (no dead iframe for stopped sessions, gentler polling):I'll verify the layouts visually with a temporary standalone preview page (auth blocks the app itself):Layout renders with adaptive 3×2 columns. The mock images failed to load (no external network), so let me use inline images and check the other layouts:All three layouts render correctly. Now let me verify the store logic itself with the real module:Let me also exercise the real store module (not a mock) in the harness:One check failed only because the accessor dispatches the *action* `deleteSession` (which calls the API). Let me confirm the mutation cleanup directly:All store behaviors verified. Let me capture the visual result, then clean up the temporary harness:There's an existing backlog card that looks related — let me check it:Implementation and verification are done. Let me record what I learned for future work in this project:Grid view for computer sessions is implemented and verified.

## What you get

**Switch mode** — a `Single | Grid` toggle sits above the stage (desktop) or in the mobile header.

**Pick the sessions** — a "Sessions" button opens a picker (checkbox list of all sessions, with All/None). First time you switch to grid it auto-fills with the machine you were watching + the running ones (max 6).

**Three adapting layouts** (buttons next to the toggle, remembered in `localStorage`):
- **`grid`** — equal tiles; columns follow the count (1 → 2 → 3 → 4, rows fill the height, no scrolling).
- **`spotlight`** — one principal machine big, filmstrip of thumbnails underneath.
- **`sidebar`** — one principal big, all thumbnails in a right rail.

**Interaction model** (like meeting software): exactly one tile is *live* and interactive — click any other tile (or its name) to promote it there; a `⤢` button opens a machine alone in single view, `✕` drops it off the wall. Each tile shows name, kind icon, running dot and who is driving (AI/hand).

## Files

<file_change path="client/src/store/browsers.js" language="javascript" change_type="update">
(modified: `viewMode`, `gridSessionIds`, `gridActiveId`, `gridLayout` state + getters `isGridView`, `gridLayout`, `gridSessionIds`, `gridActiveId`, `gridSessions`, mutations/actions `setViewMode`, `setGridLayout`, `set{Add,Remove,Toggle}GridSession`, `setGridActive`, `openSingleSession`; `deleteSession` also prunes the wall)
</file_change>

<file_change path="client/src/components/browsers/ComputerGridView.vue" language="vue" change_type="new">
Wall container: adaptive column grid, spotlight filmstrip and side-rail layouts, empty state with "Select sessions". Stateless — selection/layout/active tile live in the store.
</file_change>

<file_change path="client/src/components/browsers/ComputerGridTile.vue" language="vue" change_type="new">
One machine. Renders the real live viewer when active (`BrowserViewer` for browser kind, `DesktopViewer` otherwise), a live `iframe` for browser previews, otherwise an auto-refreshing snapshot (5 s, skipped when the tab is hidden or the session is stopped). Only one live viewer per page on purpose: the desktop viewers share KasmVNC's global `path` localStorage key, so two live desktop streams would fight over the route.
</file_change>

<file_change path="client/src/components/browsers/ComputerGridPicker.vue" language="vue" change_type="new">
"Machines on the wall" modal — works from the desktop toolbar, the mobile header and the empty wall.
</file_change>

<file_change path="client/src/components/browsers/BrowsersSessionManager.vue" language="vue" change_type="update">
Toolbar with the view toggle, the three layout buttons and the selection button; grid replaces the panel when active (desktop and mobile); picking a session in the sidebar puts it on the wall; view/layout/selection persisted in `localStorage`.
</file_change>

- Vite dev server transforms all 5 files with **HTTP 200** and the SFC compiler reports **no template errors**.
- Rendered the real components in a throwaway Vite page and measured the DOM: 5 tiles at 331×303 in **3×2 columns**, `spotlight` → principal 1008×509 + 96 px filmstrip with 5 thumbs, `sidebar` → principal 824×613 + 176 px rail with 5 thumbs; preview images loaded; no error overlay.
- Ran the **real store module** through `$storex` in that page: 14 contract checks pass (view mode, `gridSessions` dropping unknown ids, active-tile fallback after removal, layout validation) plus `deleteSession` correctly pruning the wall and moving the active tile.
- Temporary harness files were deleted; only the 3 new components + 2 modified files remain (`git status` clean otherwise).

Not exercised end-to-end: the app itself requires a login, so the toolbar inside the authenticated screen wasn't clicked — worth a 30-second look on your side. If you'd rather have **all tiles live** (no click-to-promote), that's a one-line change in `ComputerGridTile.previewMode`, but it will break KasmVNC desktops when two are shown at once — say the word and I'll gate it per kind instead.

import { createApp } from 'vue'
import './assets/main.css'
import GridPreview from './GridPreview.vue'
import { $storex } from './store/index.js'

// Minimal `$storex` stand-in: the tile only needs the computer screenshot call
// to draw its previews. Inline images keep the layout check honest without
// touching the real API (and without network access).
const frame = (sessionId) => {
  const color = { s1: '#1d4ed8', s2: '#0f766e', s3: '#7c3aed', s4: '#6b7280', s5: '#b45309' }[sessionId] || '#334155'
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="720">
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="${color}"/>
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="1160" height="80" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85"/>
    <rect x="60" y="180" width="520" height="480" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="620" y="180" width="600" height="220" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
    <text x="100" y="118" font-family="monospace" font-size="46" fill="#111827">desktop ${sessionId}</text>
  </svg>`
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(svg)
}

const app = createApp(GridPreview)
app.config.globalProperties.$storex = $storex
app.mount('#app')

// ── Store contract check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Exercises the real browsers module through the same typed-vuex accessor the
// components use, and records the outcome on window.__gridLogic.
const results = []
const check = (label, actual, expected) => {
  const ok = JSON.stringify(actual) === JSON.stringify(expected)
  results.push({ label, ok, actual, expected })
}
const b = $storex.browsers
const sessions = [
  { id: 'a', name: 'A', status: 'running' },
  { id: 'b', name: 'B', status: 'running' },
  { id: 'c', name: 'C', status: 'stopped' }
]

b.setSessions(sessions)
check('getter isGridView default', b.isGridView, false)
b.setViewMode('grid')
check('getter isGridView after setViewMode', b.isGridView, true)

b.setGridSessions(['a', 'b', 'ghost'])
check('getter gridSessionIds keeps ids', b.gridSessionIds, ['a', 'b', 'ghost'])
check('getter gridSessions drops unknown ids', b.gridSessions.map(s => s.id), ['a', 'b'])
check('active falls back to first', b.gridActiveId, 'a')

b.setGridActive('b')
check('setGridActive', b.gridActiveId, 'b')

b.toggleGridSession('b')
check('toggle removes', b.gridSessionIds, ['a', 'ghost'])
check('active moves after removing active', b.gridActiveId, 'a')

b.toggleGridSession('c')
check('toggle adds', b.gridSessionIds, ['a', 'ghost', 'c'])

b.setGridLayout('sidebar')
check('setGridLayout valid', b.gridLayout, 'sidebar')
b.setGridLayout('nope')
check('setGridLayout invalid falls back', b.gridLayout, 'grid')

b.deleteSession('c')
check('deleteSession prunes the wall', b.gridSessionIds, ['a', 'ghost'])

b.openSingleSession('b')
check('openSingleSession selects', b.selectedSessionId, 'b')
check('openSingleSession leaves the wall', b.isGridView, false)

check('no failing step', results.filter(r => !r.ok).length, 0)
window.__gridLogic = results
console.log('[grid logic]', JSON.stringify(results))
